errata_resolutions.resolution: One directed acyclic artifact graph is mandatory.
artifact_graph: A code_lock contains exact hashes of the contract, static allowlist, policy, native helper, sealed launcher, wrapper, kernel, rooted primitive, tests, and rejected-predecessor evidence. It contains neither its own digest nor any review that binds it.
A detached code_lock digest is calculated after the closed code_lock bytes exist.
Independent static checker, premortem, and boss artifacts each bind the detached code_lock digest.
A reviewed_release_record binds the detached code_lock digest plus those review hashes. It is not hashed by any predecessor.
An execution_freeze binds the detached reviewed_release_record digest and stable pre-restart scope only.
A product/runtime owner capability outside model-controlled files and inputs supplies the independently trusted execution_freeze digest to the sealed launcher.
errata_resolutions.external_trust_anchor: A specific product/runtime capability API outside the workspace and model-controlled inputs. It does not currently exist; therefore canonical readiness is permanently false until independently established.
forbidden: launcher constant that authenticates an object containing the launcher hash
code lock containing reviews that hash that code lock
any direct or transitive hash cycle
workspace JSON environment variable or CLI text substituted for the external trust anchor

errata_resolutions.resolution: Stable pre-restart expectations and ephemeral post-restart observations are disjoint.
stable_execution_freeze_fields: task book application family and one-shot phase scope
exact target sentinel parent and leaf allowlists
target sentinel root parent and executable file identities hashes sizes link counts
volume root workspace model and canonical-parent stable identities
Windows build architecture NTFS volume and process classification allowlists
permitted controller executable file identities and hashes
ephemeral_live_only_fields: HANDLE values and process signaled state
errata_resolutions.continuity_rule: Ephemeral fields are measured after restart and bound only from prepare through publish inside the same process-local lease; they never appear as pre-restart expected values.

errata_resolutions.resolution: All authority-bearing final checks precede one terminal completed transition.
errata_resolutions.postcompleted_drift: Classify canonical state unknown, retain evidence, forbid automatic forward writes and automatic rollback over unknown bytes, and require a separate human incident decision. Never rewrite completed to recovery_required.

errata_resolutions.resolution: Windows process liveness and uncertainty are fail-closed.
errata_resolutions.running_test: WaitForSingleObject(process_handle, 0) must equal WAIT_TIMEOUT and the PID plus creation token plus executable identity must remain exact.
errata_resolutions.test_reporting: Unavailable privilege or access is coverage_unavailable, never PASS.

errata_resolutions.resolution: Hardlinks are categorically disallowed for this one-shot operation.
errata_resolutions.rule: Every target and sentinel must have a supported NTFS link-count observation exactly equal to one at stable freeze, prepare, every pre-replacement check, fresh publish measurement, and final pre-completed validation. Any extra or unmeasurable link is a hard block.

errata_resolutions.resolution: Read-only and synthetic-transaction evidence are separate receipts.
errata_resolutions.read_only_receipt: Proves zero target/sentinel byte and member delta; access metadata and cloud hydration uncertainty are separately disclosed.
errata_resolutions.synthetic_transaction_receipt: Lists exact intended disposable-fixture byte transitions, proves zero out-of-scope changes, records deliberate terminal fixture state or separately verified rollback, and is never described as canonical execution or zero-byte-delta collection.

errata_resolutions.resolution: Review classes and lease timing are explicit.
errata_resolutions.inside_live_lease: Only pre-frozen deterministic read-only functions run synchronously in the same process. No human wait, asynchronous agent, cross-process lease transfer, or new discretionary review occurs.
errata_resolutions.expiry_rule: If every required live check cannot finish before the monotonic deadline, close/discard the lease without publication.

errata_resolutions.resolution: The missing external owner capability is a permanent current stop, not an implementation TODO that local code may bypass.

preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.reason: Even corrected deterministic design cannot exclude every preopened future hidden kernel sync ancestor-thread or noncooperating writer during replacement-compatible windows.
